nodes.description: Mapping tracking the game number each player last registered in; read in betConditions and canBet, written in placeBet.
Mapping marking addresses confirmed as winners (1) or not (0); gates betting and withdrawal.
Mapping from winning player number to the address that bet on it.
Number of players required to close a round (initialized to 25).
Bet amount in wei required from each player (initialized to 0.005 ether).
Current number of players registered in the running game.
Payout amount computed for the winner withdraw.
Block number used as source of randomness for the winner reveal.
Incrementing game/round identifier used to invalidate old registrations.
Cached address of this contract, used for balance checks.
Contract owner address, set at construction and changeable via transferOwnership.
Address of the most recent winner, exposed through canBet.
Constructor: initializes contract state, sets owner to msg.sender and lastWinner to msg.sender.
Owner-only ownership transfer guarded by onlyOwner and zero-address check.
Owner-only bet amount update, restricted by changeBetConditions (no players, empty balance).
View helper returning betting status, player count and last winner for msg.sender.
Payable entry point where players register, increment playerCount and store address by number.
Reveals the pseudorandom winner from blockhash, confirms the winner and pays out currentBet.
Winner-only withdrawal that computes the jackpot and transfers it to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, player identity, winner lookup and transfer recipient.
msg.sender.transfer(currentBet) external value transfer inside revealWinner.
msg.sender.transfer(jackpot) external value transfer inside winnerWithdraw.
Winner number derived from uint(block.blockhash(revealBlock)) % currentPlayersRequired + 1; weak randomness and unchecked arithmetic.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the proposed new owner address.
Parameter of changeBet holding the new bet amount.
Local flag returned by canBet indicating whether the caller may bet.
Local copy of playerCount returned by canBet.
Local copy of lastWinner returned by canBet.
Local copy of block.number captured in revealWinner for the 255-block check.
Local winning player number computed from blockhash modulo in revealWinner.
Local winning address looked up from numberToAddress in revealWinner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during construction, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing ownership transfer.
changeBet is gated by onlyOwner which validates msg.sender against owner.
betConditions uses msg.sender to read playerRegistrationStatus and confirmedWinners before accepting the bet.
revealWinner has no caller restriction but the payout recipient is msg.sender.
winnerWithdrawConditions requires confirmedWinners[msg.sender] == 1 before withdrawal.
msg.sender receives the currentBet transfer from the revealWinner payout.
msg.sender receives the jackpot transfer from winnerWithdraw.
newOwner parameter flows into the ownership transfer logic.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the owner state variable.
_newBet parameter is consumed by the owner-restricted changeBet function.
changeBet writes _newBet into the currentBet state variable.
canBet reads playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] to compute the status flag.
canBet compares playerRegistrationStatus against currentGame.
canBet copies playerCount into the returned tuple.
canBet copies lastWinner into the returned tuple.
_status local variable is assigned and returned by canBet.
_playerCount local variable is assigned and returned by canBet.
_lastWinner local variable is assigned and returned by canBet.
betConditions compares stored registration against currentGame before accepting a bet.
betConditions requires playerCount < currentPlayersRequired.
betConditions requires msg.value == currentBet.
betConditions requires confirmedWinners[msg.sender] == 0 to block prior winners.
placeBet increments and reads playerCount to seat the player.
placeBet writes playerRegistrationStatus[msg.sender] = currentGame.
placeBet stores msg.sender in numberToAddress indexed by playerCount.
placeBet increments playerCount.
placeBet sets revealBlock = block.number when the round fills.
revealWinner reads revealBlock to derive the winner and to validate the 255-block window.
_thisBlock caches block.number inside revealWinner.
revealWinner computes the winning number by modulo of blockhash, an unchecked arithmetic derivation of randomness.
The blockhash modulo result is stored in the _winningNumber local variable.
revealWinner looks up numberToAddress[_winningNumber] to find the winning address.
_winningNumber indexes numberToAddress inside revealWinner.
_winningAddress holds the resolved winner used for state updates and payout.
revealWinner resets playerCount to 0 for the next round.
revealWinner increments currentGame.
revealWinner sets confirmedWinners[_winningAddress] = 1, granting withdrawal rights.
revealWinner updates lastWinner with the winning address.
revealWinner pays currentBet to msg.sender via an external transfer after state updates.
winnerWithdrawConditions requires confirmedWinners[msg.sender] == 1.
winnerWithdraw clears confirmedWinners[msg.sender] to 0 before paying out.
winnerWithdraw reads currentBet when computing the jackpot.
winnerWithdraw reads currentPlayersRequired when computing the jackpot.
jackpot = currentBet * (currentPlayersRequired - 1) is an unchecked multiplication written to jackpot.
winnerWithdraw transfers the computed jackpot to msg.sender externally.
